newsitem.title: USA: Dog track building collapses in Miami.
newsitem.headline: Dog track building collapses in Miami.

text.p: The roof of a dog racing club collapsed during demolition in a Miami suburb Friday, trapping several workers inside the the rubble, police said.
Seven men were believed to be inside when the Biscayne Kennel Club collapsed. Rescue crews brought out three of the victims, but the extent of their injuries was unknown.
Firefighters with search dogs were still trying to reach the other workers.
The building in Miami Shores north of Miami was at least 70 years old, and was scheduled to be torn down Friday.
